visual.title: A negative discriminant rules out a hyperbola
visual.caption: The six-term equation x² + 0.25y² − 2x + y + 1 = 0 has A = 1, B = 0 and C = 0.25. Its discriminant is B² − 4AC = −1, so the curve is an ellipse, not a hyperbola. The figure shows its centre at (1, −2).

predict.question: For x² + 0.25y² − 2x + y + 1 = 0, what is B² − 4AC?
predict.explain: With B = 0, A = 1 and C = 0.25, B² − 4AC = 0 − 4(1)(0.25) = −1. A negative discriminant means an ellipse. The linear terms translate the centre but do not change the type.
